title: Stockfish for Soccer
description: An analysis of soccer passing sequences using a custom-built predictive model, this website aims to provide insights into passing patterns and strategies in soccer games.

title: eSports Predictive Analysis
description: Predicting the outcomes within a game of League of Legends using predictive modeling techniques. The project aims to provide insights into the factors that influence the outcome of a game, helping players and teams make informed decisions.

title: The Ideal Running Tool
description: This project aims to provide the ideal running workout given a person's biometrics and workout goals, using a knn model and athletic data from a Valencia 2017 study.

title: NBA Injuries and Rest Days Analysis
description: An analysis of how teams in the NBA are affected by injuries and varying amounts of rest. The project analyzes how rest days are scheduled, assesess fairness, and utilizes data visualization techniques to present findings..

title: Environmental Challenge Project
description: Examined a multitude of different solutions to reduce water usage at the Sea-Tac Airport in a cost-effective and environmentally friendly way, achieving 3rd place overall in the competition.
